svg.title: From a mention in the thread to a function in the code
svg.desc: Left: the five ways a thread points at code, strongest evidence first: a stack frame, a review comment on a line, a file path, a name in backticks, and a file a diff touches. Right: the mention is resolved at one commit of the clone. Line 212 of pkg/io.py lies in the method read, lines 190 to 229, inside the class Reader, and the context lists that range with the evidence and the event it came from. An open pull request that changes lines 205 to 214 falls in the same range, so the context lists it as also in progress.
svg.text: How a thread points at code
Strongest evidence first. That is the order of the list.
Resolved at one commit of your clone
A line maps to the innermost function or type around it.
line 212, where the stack frame points
With line ranges, an open pull request that changes the
same function can be found by overlap:
## Also in progress on this code
A bare name is looked up first in files the thread names.
One defined in more than three places is dropped.
